audit_items.proof_trace: Every mutation path that modifies any individual investedCapital[i] applies an equal and symmetric change to totalCapitalInvested: invest increments both by amount (L101-104), refund zeros investedCapital and subtracts the same amount from totalCapitalInvested (AbstractSale:179-185), withdrawExcessInvestedCapital decrements both by amount (AbstractSale:341-344), and withdrawInvestedCapitalIfCanceled zeros investedCapital and subtracts from totalCapitalInvested (AbstractSale:462-465). The position-merge path in _burnOrTransferInvestorPosition transfers investedCapital between entries without modifying totalCapitalInvested, preserving the aggregate sum.
